nusmp.skill.book_light.description: The grimoire of Light Magic after the Black Clover wiki: golden-white light, the fastest magic there is. Swords of light thrown at light speed, a whip, a lance of light that splits the sky, a column and a rain of arrows from the heavens, the blinding Lamp of Avior, a healing sphere and the giant Absolute Monarch of Divine Brilliance. Light ignores armour and cuts the spirit; only an Aura barrier holds it back. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_bone.description: The grimoire of Bone Magic after the Black Clover wiki: the user grows and shapes their own bones. Bone Bullets from the palm, countless Eternal Fangs pushed out of the body, the Demon Sword Dainsleif coated in Spatial Magic and the flying slashes of Spatial Rupture, besides Bone Armor, Rib Cage and Bone Rain. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_light.judgment: Light Sword of Judgment (審判の光剣, Shinpan no Kōken) - 4 to 8 shards of light with four lines running through each rise beside you and are thrown one after another at light speed, each ending in a golden-white cross-slash. 5 light damage each (more with EP); light ignores armour and cuts the spirit, only an Aura barrier halves it. Patolli's spell, copied by Rhya.
nusmp.page.book_light.divine_punishment: Light Shaft of Divine Punishment (神罰の光芒, Shinbatsu no Kōbō) - a ring of light marks the ground under the foe you look at (it follows the foe), then a giant column of light falls from the sky and pulses three times, hurting and lifting everything in it. Radius 2.6 to 4 blocks by EP. Patolli's strongest light spell.
nusmp.page.book_light.healing_ray: Healing Ray of Light (癒やしの光粒, Iyashi no Kōryū) - a sphere of white light with a halo ring settles on the ally you look at (or you) and mends 5% of their health three times, burning away one affliction at the first pulse; allies within 3.5 blocks share half of it. Heals are capped by the healing law.
nusmp.page.book_light.lamp_of_avior: Lamp of Avior Gloria (アヴィオールの灯・栄光, Aviōru no Tomoshibi: Gloria) - a huge black-and-white manga-style burst of spikes swells over you for 1.3 seconds and goes off with a blinding flash over 14 blocks: heavy light damage that falls off with distance, blindness and a hard push, then a second weaker pulse. Lumiere's great spell.
nusmp.page.book_light.light_speed: Light Speed (光速移動, Kōsoku Idō) - become light and arrive up to 24 blocks ahead in an instant, cutting through what stands between. Uses aura. Kept from the old book: speed is the defining trait of Light Magic.
nusmp.page.book_light.bright_judgment_wh: Bright Judgment Whip (裁きの光鞭, Sabaki no Kōben) - three long curling whips of light lash out from your hand in a fan, each hitting everything along 13 blocks and dragging what it catches a little towards you. Patolli's Creation-style light spell.
nusmp.page.book_light.heaven_splitting_f: Heaven-Splitting Flash (裂天の閃光, Retten no Senkō) - after a short charge a huge beam of light with bright points along it pierces everything in a straight line up to 30 blocks, hurting and pushing each foe (up to 12). Rhya copied it from Patolli.
nusmp.page.book_light.arrows_of_judgment: Arrows of Judgment (審判の矢, Shinpan no Ya) - a ring marks where you aim (or the foe you look at) and 12 to 20 arrows of light rain down over a crowd within 8 blocks, each bursting where it lands (at most 24 foes touched per cast). Patolli's area spell.
nusmp.page.book_light.avior_lamp: Lamp of Avior (アヴィオールの灯, Aviōru no Tomoshibi) - light gathers round your raised hand, then the concentrated orb is thrown and goes off in a blinding spiky starburst: 6 blocks, light damage, blindness and a push. The lesser form of the Lamp of Avior Gloria.
nusmp.page.book_light.absolute_monarch: Absolute Monarch of Divine Brilliance (神聖なる光輝の絶対君主, Shinsei naru Kōki no Zettai Kunshu) - a giant of golden light with a yellow rim stands behind you for 12 seconds: it shelters you and the allies near you (a little resistance, a trickle of healing) and strikes the nearest foe within 14 blocks every 1.5 seconds. One giant at a time. A supplementary spell.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_spear: Bone Bullets (骨弾, Kotsudan) - 3 to 5 sharp bone fragments are fired one after another from a hole in your palm, spinning to bore through armour (half of it is ignored). Lucius Zogratis' Bone Magic. Replaces the Bone Spear.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_armor: Bone Armor (骨の鎧, Hone no Yoroi) - your bones grow into a shell that soaks damage (absorption) and bites back. Kept from the old book; Zenon's bones block nearly every blow.
nusmp.page.book_bone.ossuary: Eternal Fangs (無間骨牙, Mugen Kotsuga) - 16 to 24 countless bones are pushed out of your body in every direction, in three waves, too fast and too many to dodge: 9 blocks, three hits each, half the armour ignored, walls stop them. Zenon Zogratis' great spell. Replaces the Ossuary.
nusmp.page.book_bone.rib_cage: Rib Cage (肋骨の檻, Rokkotsu no Ori) - bones burst up round a target and lock it in place. Kept from the old book: bones that grow, merge and branch.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_rain: Bone Rain (骨雨, Kotsuu) - shards of bone rain down on an area for seconds. Kept from the old book.
nusmp.page.book_bone.demon_sword_dainsle: Demon Sword Dainsleif (魔剣ダーインスレイヴ, Maken Dāinsureivu) - a bone sword coated in offensive Spatial Magic cuts three close-range arcs in front of you; space itself is cut, so nearly all armour is ignored. Zenon Zogratis' union of Bone and Spatial Magic.
nusmp.page.book_bone.spatial_rupture: Spatial Rupture (空間断裂, Kūkan Danretsu) - you swing the Demon Sword Dainsleif and 1 to 3 flying slashes of cut space leave it, piercing everything in their way for 15 blocks and ignoring nearly all armour. Zenon Zogratis' Bone and Spatial Magic.
